description: Non material amendment to planning permission 24/3701/S73 dated 25/02/2025 for 'Variation of condition 1 (Approved Plans) of planning permission reference 19/5453/FUL dated 28/02/20 for "Conversion and alterations (including demolition of rear modern extension) of Oak Lodge to create residential units. Erection of three residential buildings (Blocks A, B and C). Excavation to form lower ground and basement levels below north wing, south east block and south west block. Lower ground level to include lower floor of ground floor duplexes in each block and ancillary leisure facilities with access from a single storey pavilion in the central courtyard. Basement to include ancillary cycle parking, motorcycle parking and car parking (x49 spaces), refuse store, plant and storage rooms. Erection of detached operations building and circular ramp with access to basement. Associated landscaping including formation of central courtyard, tree removals, replacement tree planting, soft landscaping and formation of secondary access to The Bishops Avenue and associated works." Amendments include minor design changes to building facades necessitated as the scheme as progressed. Key revisions to Blocks A, B, and C include omission of brick piers and louvres, increased window sill levels, and the removal of access stairs at Block C
